def_standard_large_shield_generator_desc:
'''Only one shield generator can be equipped at a time.'''

When equipped onto a robot this module emits a protective power field to stop incoming damage by using up the accumulator's energy. This accumulator unit/damage conversion rate is displayed as the AP/HP measure. There is however a major drawback to this kind of defense: when the shield is turned on, you cannot use any of your own weapons.

def_standart_mining_turret_desc: Fully-automated, AI-powered, deployable turret that is designed to gather any underground resources. Periodically drops mined resources.

Unfortunately, any changes in Niani brains leads to a set of catastrofic damages, so only basic functions are retained. Zombie bot can only follow it's master and attack his primary target, but even that allowed Syndicate to create combat drones. This one was once Nuimqol and thus operates with magnetic weapons.

def_terramotus_bot_desc:
'''Класс:''' Destroyer-class industrial robot specialized in mining and support

'''Фракция:''' Nian Industrial Trust

Towering above its counterparts, the Terramotus is the ultimate symbol of the Nian Industrial Trust's raw power. As the only robot capable of wielding large driller modules, it mines entire swathes of terrain effortlessly, shaking the ground and excavating deep, valuable materials from 9 nodes at once. But its role extends beyond brute strength. The Terramotus emits field bonuses that enhance the efficiency of industrial NEXUS modules, turning any mining operation into a well-oiled machine. Silent and unstoppable, the Terramotus reshapes landscapes and economies with each seismic pulse, embodying the Trust's quiet dominance over NiaвЂ™s industrial warfare.

def_vektor_bot_desc:
'''Класс:''' Light robot specialized in firearms

'''Фракция:''' Синдикат: Экономическая боевая линия

''Созданная человеком технология, полученная путем обратного проектирования технологии Ниан. Дёшево, но не так эффективно, как натуральные модели.''

The smallest member of our hybrid-technology fleet of robots. Its armor is weaker than the average, but its small size makes up for it, resulting in a hard to hit target. Coupled with excellent detection and masking systems, the Vektor makes not only a good scout, but a tough opponent in combat as well.
def_wall_bomb_a_desc:
'''A bomb designed for destroying walls in a small area'''

The Syndicate have been made aware of some ''impediments'' to their agents from fully exploiting the lands of the outer Beta regions.
To ameliorate the situation, the Syndicate has provided this curious device.

This device, when activated, will ''decompile'' nearby walls and plants to assist in Agent movement.
def_wall_bomb_b_desc:
'''A bomb designed for destroying walls in a small area'''

Syndicate Laboratories have improved upon their first ''impediment remover'' with this new variant, claiming a much smaller chance of detection at high ranges.  Though to maintain this it does take a bit longer to kick off the fireworks.

When asked about this delay, lab staff responded:

''You want fast bomb? We give you fast bomb. You want sneaky bomb? We give you sneaky bomb. You want fast-sneaky bomb?  We think customer should ask less questions of scientists that make bomb...'' - Syndicate Labs Representative

ext_command_robotics_desc:
'''4th level''' enables controlling of command bots.

In addition, each level of the extension multiplies the bonuses of command robots by the number of the level.
ext_cruise_missiles_desc: Each level of this extension raises the firepower of large missile launchers by an additional {%BONUS100%}%.
ext_drone_amplification_accuracy_desc: Each level of this extension increases drones weapons accuracy by an additional 3%. Affects both turrets and missiles.
ext_drone_amplification_armor_max_desc: Each level of this extension increases drones max armor by an additional 5%.
ext_drone_amplification_core_max_desc: Each level of this extension increases drones max accumulator capacity by an additional 3%.
ext_drone_amplification_core_recharge_ti: Each level of this extension decreases the recharge time of drones accumulator by an additional 3%.
ext_drone_amplification_cycle_time_desc: Each level of this extension decreases the cycle time of drones weapons by an additional 5%.
ext_drone_amplification_damage_desc: Each level of this extension increases the drones weapons damage by an additional 8.5%.
ext_drone_amplification_harvesting_amoun: Each level of this extension increases the drones harvesting amount of any plants by an additional 5%.
ext_drone_amplification_locking_time_des: Each level of this extension decreases the drones locking time of a target by an additional 7%.
ext_drone_amplification_long_range_desc: Each level of this extension increases the drones weapons optimal range by an additional 3%.
ext_drone_amplification_mining_amount_de: Each level of this extension increases the drones mining amount of any ore by an additional 5%.
ext_drone_amplification_reactor_radiatio: Each level of this extension increases the reactor stability of drones by an additional 3%.
ext_drone_amplification_remote_repair_am: Each level of this extension increases the drones remote armor repair amount by an additional 2%.
ext_drone_amplification_remote_repair_cy: Each level of this extension decreases the drones remote armor repair cycle time by an additional 5%.
ext_drone_amplification_speed_max_desc: Each level of this extension increases the maximum speed of drones by an additional 5%.
ext_electric_damage_desc: Each point of this extension increases electric damage of Scorchers by 10% of base value
ext_flux_miner_expert_desc: Each level of this extension raises the amount of exploited '''Flux Ore''' in each cycle by an additional {%BONUS100%}%
ext_flux_mining_buffer_expert_desc: Each level of this extension reduces the cycle time of '''Flux Ore''' exploitation by an additional {%BONUS100%}%
ext_harvesting_turrets_experience_desc: Each two levels of this extension allows you to use more advanced harvesting turrets.
ext_mining_turrets_experience_desc: Each two levels of this extension allows you to use more advanced mining turrets.
ext_missile_falloff_desc: Each level of this extension raises the maximum range of missiles' falloff by an additional {%BONUS100%}%.
ext_nox_management_advanced_desc: Each level of this extension raises the effect range of all your NOX modules by an additional 20%.
ext_nox_management_basic_desc: Each level of this extension raises the effect range of your NOX modules by an additional 10%
ext_nox_repair_negation_desc: Each level of this extension raises the efficiency of Repairer NOX modules by an additional 1%.
ext_nox_shield_negation_desc: Each level of this extension raises the efficiency of Shield NOX modules by an additional 1%.
ext_nuimqol_combat_drones_experience_des: Each two levels of this extension allows you to use more advanced nuimqol combat drones.
ext_pelistal_combat_drones_experience_de: Each two levels of this extension allows you to use more advanced pelistal combat drones.
ext_rcm_cpu_upgrade_desc: Each level of this extension reduces the CPU usage of remote controllers by an additional 3%.
ext_rcm_powergrid_upgrade_desc: Each level of this extension reduces the reactor usage of remote controllers by an additional 3%.
ext_remote_control_desc: Each level of this extension extends your remote controller bandwidth by 1.
ext_remote_control_lifetime_management_d: Each level of this extension increases remote controlled units lifetime for additional 60 seconds.
ext_remote_control_long_range_drone_oper: Each level of this extension increases remote controlled units operational range for additional 50m
ext_sentry_turrets_experience_desc: Each two levels of this extension allows you to use more advanced sentry turrets.
ext_thelodica_combat_drones_experience_d: Each two levels of this extension allows you to use more advanced thelodica combat drones.
powergrid_usage_large_laser_modifier: Reactor usage of large laser weapons
powergrid_usage_large_missile_modifier: Reactor usage of large missile launchers
powergrid_usage_large_railgun_modifier: Reactor usage of large magnetic launchers
